> raised from the sale of patches.**                                                                
>                                                                                                   
> **2004 � FoBM spent hours sanding the tower, replacing all the wooden components & and wire along 
> the stairs. DEC coordinated a helicopter drop of supplies in September. Volunteers also repaired  
> the concrete footers and repainted the entire tower.**

> **2005 � Thanks to our grassroot fundraising effort and all our dedicated volunteers, FoBM and DEC
> met on the summit on June 18, 2005 for a dedication ceremony for the re-opening of the fire tower 
> on Bald (Rondaxe) Mountain. **                                                                    
>                                                                                                   
> **2006 � DEC began expanded the parking area on the Rondaxe Rd. FoBM installed a new map table in 
> the cab.**                                                                                        
>                                                                                                   
> **2007 � The 90^{th} year anniversary of the Fire Tower on Bald Mt. FoBM signed another 5-year    
> �Adopt-A-Natural-Resource Agreement with DEC. New expanded parking lot now open to visitors.**    
>                                                                                                   
> **2008 � New Kiosk opens in the parking area which included a sign-in register.**

> **2009 � FoBM volunteer Larry Coon from Rochester replaced the swinging security door into the    
> cab. The original door was designed by DEC Forester Fred Munk but vandalized in 2008. Repainting  
> graffiti out of the cab, staining the stairs and cab flooring, picking up trash and clearing

> Stillwater Mountain friends group.**

[Fall Foliage View - Courtesy of Fred Knauf]                                                        
                                                                                                    
**Bald Mountain Fire Tower Restoration 2002-2025 Brief Summary**                                    
                                                                                                    
> **1990 � Bald Mountain Fire Tower Officially Closed by NYS DEC**                                  
>                                                                                                   
> **2002 � A Bald Mountain Steering Committee was formed and signed an agreement called             
> �Adopt-A-Natural-Resource agreement with DEC.**                                                   
>                                                                                                   
> **2003 � Workdays for the group, now called the �Friends of Bald Mountain (FoBM) began with funds 
> raised from the sale of patches.**                                                                
>                                                                                                   
> **2004 � FoBM spent hours sanding the tower, replacing all the wooden components & and wire along 
> the stairs. DEC coordinated a helicopter drop of supplies in September. Volunteers also repaired  
> the concrete footers and repainted the entire tower.**                                            
>                                                                                                   
> **2005 � Thanks to our grassroot fundraising effort and all our dedicated volunteers, FoBM and DEC
> met on the summit on June 18, 2005 for a dedication ceremony for the re-opening of the fire tower 
> on Bald (Rondaxe) Mountain. **                                                                    
>                                                                                                   
> **2006 � DEC began expanded the parking area on the Rondaxe Rd. FoBM installed a new map table in 
> the cab.**                                                                                        
>                                                                                                   
> **2007 � The 90^{th} year anniversary of the Fire Tower on Bald Mt. FoBM signed another 5-year    
> �Adopt-A-Natural-Resource Agreement with DEC. New expanded parking lot now open to visitors.**    
>                                                                                                   
> **2008 � New Kiosk opens in the parking area which included a sign-in register.**                 
>                                                                                                   
> **2009 � FoBM volunteer Larry Coon from Rochester replaced the swinging security door into the    
> cab. The original door was designed by DEC Forester Fred Munk but vandalized in 2008. Repainting  
> graffiti out of the cab, staining the stairs and cab flooring, picking up trash and clearing      
> debris on the trail were some of the annual workday projects by FoBM in 2010 & 2011.**            
>                                                                                                   
> **2012 � FoBM celebrates our 10^{th} year maintaining the Bald Mountain Fire Tower. Once again,   
> Larry Coon replaced the swinging door into the tower that was damaged by vandals.**               
>                                                                                                   
> **2013 � FoBM morn the loss of our project manager and charter member Jack Ball. Routine annual   
> maintenance continued in 2013 & 2014. FoBM shared our experiences with the newly formed Friends of
> Stillwater Mountain friends group.**                                                              
>                                                                                                   
> **2015 � FoBM patches SOLD OUT. Our thanks to the Old Forge Hardware Store & Kiefer�s Souvenir    
> Village in Old Forge who helped with this essential fundraising effort.**                         
>                                                                                                   
> **2016 � The entire cab was repainted by work groups this year. A plaque was ordered to mount on  
> the swinging security door next year for the steel tower�s 100^{th} anniversary.**                
>                                                                                                   
> **2017 � 100^{th} Anniversary of the steel fire tower on Bald Mt. Our new plaque was installed on 
> the doorway into the cab.**                                                                       
>                                                                                                   
> **2018 - Thanks to a new map from Larry Coon, it was mounted in the cab by volunteer Paul         
> Scheidelman and other volunteers. FoBM volunteer Ron Walker led a group up in August to           
> participate in the Light Up the Fire Towers from 9:00-9:30pm. The event was promoted by the NYS   
> Chapter of the Forest Fire Lookout Association.**                                                 
>                                                                                                   
> **2019 � Three FoBM volunteers attended the DEC's UMP for the Fulton Chain of Lakes meeting that  
> was held in Old Forge in June to request additional parking on the Rondaxe Rd. The UMP for this   
> area was last updated in 1990 and this meeting allowed participants to express ideas that DEC may 
> consider implementing for our region. During their presentation, DEC acknowledged that more than  
> 30,000 hikers signed the register here during the past three years! **                            
>                                                                                                   
> **2020-2021 � The Pandemic Years � hiking was a relatively safe outing for thousands of visitors  
> to the Adirondacks. The Bald Mountain Fire Tower had a record number of hikers during the past two
> years. Work in the cab, including the installation of a new map table, was postponed due to social
> distancing guidelines during the pandemic. Sadly, our swinging door with the 100th Anniversary    
> plaque was ripped off and the entrance to the cab and likely thrown over the cliffs. **           
>                                                                                                   
> **Local Fire Departments held 911 memorial ceremonies on the summit in September the past two     
> years. The event was organized by FoBM volunteer and Old Forge FD volunteer Carol Perkins to pay  
> tribute to all the first responders who lost their lives on 911, responding to save the lives of  
> victims of that horrific terrorist attack. **                                                     
>                                                                                                   
> **2022-2023 � The Post-Pandemic Years � The Bald Mountain Fire Tower continued to have record     
> numbers of hikers during the past two years. Thanks to several new volunteers, especially Fred K. 
> from Rochester, we have completed the installation of a new safety door into the cab and a new map
> table. FoBM have painted out the graffiti in the cab too and removed additional graffiti from the 
> kiosk at the trailhead. Our volunteers are faithfully picking up trash, which remains minimal,    
> thanks to all our thoughtful visitors. Most recently - the DEC Boonville operations crew cut all  
> new steps and DEC operations supervisor Jeff Abrial informed us they were all installed in        
> November. Amazing job - we thank your crew Jeff and all the other folks who have contributed to   
> maintaining this historic site for another generation of visitors.   **                           
>                                                                                                   
> **2025 - we wish all our supporters a Very Healthy & Happy New Year. Our new Co-Chairs for the    
> upcoming year are Carol Perkins of Old Forge and Fred Knauf of Rochester. Under their leadership, 
> we will continue to work with our DEC partners to preserve the Bald Mountain Fire Tower for all   
> our visitors who climb to this landmark site in the Old Forge, New York area. **                  
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[Comments, Additional Resources or Questions?][2]

Last updated: December 2025

## Why do people love jigsaw puzzles?

#### Jigsaw puzzles are a brain-boosting pastime. Assembling the pieces enhances memory,
#### problem-solving, and spatial reasoning.

The activity fosters concentration, patience, and a sense of accomplishment. Regular puzzle-solving
is linked to improved cognitive function and may reduce the risk of neurodegenerative diseases.
Puzzling is not just a game – it's a therapeutic workout for your mind. The process requires
concentration and attention to detail, fostering improved focus and patience. In essence, the simple
act of piecing together a jigsaw puzzle transcends leisure, becoming a therapeutic activity that
nurtures the mind and promotes mental well-being.

# Free Online Games at CrazyGames

CrazyGames features the latest and best free online games. You can enjoy playing fun games without
interruptions from downloads, intrusive ads, or pop-ups. Just load up your favorite games instantly
in your web browser and enjoy the experience.

You can play our games on desktop and mobile devices. That includes everything from desktop PCs,
laptops, and Chromebooks, to the latest smartphones and tablets from Apple and Android. You can also
install CrazyGames as a mobile app, both on [Android][66] and on [iOS][67].

## About CrazyGames

There are plenty of online multiplayer games with active communities on CrazyGames. You can find
many of the best free multiplayer titles on our[ .io games ][68]page. In these games, you can play
with your friends online and with other people from around the world, no matter where you are.

## Play our Best Games

CrazyGames has over 4,500 fun games in every genre you can imagine. Some of our most popular games
are:
* [Shell Shockers][69]
* [Agar io][70]
* [Uno Online][71]
* [Geometry Dash][72]
* [Moto X3M][73]
* [Smash Karts][74]
* [GeoGuessr][75]
* [Hangman][76]

## Explore by Genre

You’ll find the main categories like [clicker][77], [driving games][78], and [shooting games][79] at
the top of any page, but there’s also a range of subcategories that will help you find the perfect
game. Popular tags include [car games][80], [Minecraft][81], [2-player games][82], [match 3
games][83], and [mahjong.][84]

## Suggest a Game

Is there a game that you love, but you can't find on CrazyGames? [Suggest a game][85] to us, and
we'll see what we can do to get it. You can also [contact us][86] for any general suggestions or
improvements.

## About CrazyGames

CrazyGames is a free browser gaming platform founded in 2014 by Raf Mertens. Since then, the
platform has grown to over 30 million monthly users.

Our mission is simple: to create a browser-gaming platform that works seamlessly for users around
the world and rewards developers both big and small. Visit our corporate site and learn more [about
CrazyGames][87].

## What is Dle Games?

[Dle Games][215] is your ultimate directory for discovering and playing **random dle games to
play**inspired by the viral word puzzle phenomenon. From classic word guessing to geography
challenges, music quizzes, and sports trivia, we've curated the best collection of daily puzzle
games that will keep you entertained and challenged.

Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser during your coffee break or want to explore new
puzzle formats, our collection features games across multiple categories including Word, Geography,
Music, Movies & TV, Gaming, Sports, Math, and more. Use our search and filter tools to find your
next favorite game, or hit the "Random Game" button to discover something new!

## What is Dle Games?

[Dle Games][215] is your ultimate directory for discovering and playing **random dle games to
play**inspired by the viral word puzzle phenomenon. From classic word guessing to geography
challenges, music quizzes, and sports trivia, we've curated the best collection of daily puzzle
games that will keep you entertained and challenged.

Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser during your coffee break or want to explore new
puzzle formats, our collection features games across multiple categories including Word, Geography,
Music, Movies & TV, Gaming, Sports, Math, and more. Use our search and filter tools to find your
next favorite game, or hit the "Random Game" button to discover something new!

### Proces produkcji puzzli, gier planszowych i kart do gier.

Jak to działa?

Wystarczą 4 proste kroki, aby Twój własny produkt był gotowy do użycia.

Krok 1
Krok 2
Krok 3
Krok 4

KROK 1: PARAMETRY TECHNICZNE

**Powiedz, czego oczekujesz od swojego produktu**

Wspólnie ustalimy wszystkie kluczowe parametry techniczne gry, kart lub puzzli, w tym: użyte
materiały, technologię produkcji, zabezpieczenie przed otwarciem, rozmiar zamówienia, a nawet czas
jego realizacji.

KROK 2: PROJEKT GRAFICZNY

**Prześlij projekt lub zdaj się na wsparcie naszych grafików**

Udostępnij swoje materiały lub opowiedz nam o swojej koncepcji, a ich opracowaniem zajmie się nasz
dedykowany zespół.  Na tej podstawie przygotujemy dla Ciebie kilka wersji projektów, spośród których
wybierzesz ten, który zostanie przekazany do produkcji.

KROK 3: PRODUKCJA

**Zaakceptuj i czekaj na rezultaty**

Gdy ustalenie wszystkich parametrów i projektów będzie już za nami - w kolejnym etapie przejdziemy
do finalizacji zamówienia. Wyprodukujemy gry lub puzzle - w wysokiej jakości i zgodne z Twoimi
oczekiwaniami.

KROK 4: DOSTAWA

**Odbierz przesyłkę z Twoimi własnymi produktami**

Na “ostatniej prostej” zapakujemy produkty w dobrze zabezpieczone kartony zbiorcze oraz umieścimy je
na palecie. Następnie przekażemy bezpośrednio do firmy kurierskiej, która dopilnuje, aby dotarły do
Ciebie szybko i sprawnie - prosto pod wskazany adres.

### Proces produkcji puzzli, gier planszowych i kart do gier.

Jak to działa?

Wystarczą 4 proste kroki, aby Twój własny produkt był gotowy do użycia.

Krok 1
Krok 2
Krok 3
Krok 4

KROK 1: PARAMETRY TECHNICZNE

**Powiedz, czego oczekujesz od swojego produktu**

Wspólnie ustalimy wszystkie kluczowe parametry techniczne gry, kart lub puzzli, w tym: użyte
materiały, technologię produkcji, zabezpieczenie przed otwarciem, rozmiar zamówienia, a nawet czas
jego realizacji.

KROK 2: PROJEKT GRAFICZNY

**Prześlij projekt lub zdaj się na wsparcie naszych grafików**

Udostępnij swoje materiały lub opowiedz nam o swojej koncepcji, a ich opracowaniem zajmie się nasz
dedykowany zespół.  Na tej podstawie przygotujemy dla Ciebie kilka wersji projektów, spośród których
wybierzesz ten, który zostanie przekazany do produkcji.

KROK 3: PRODUKCJA

**Zaakceptuj i czekaj na rezultaty**

Gdy ustalenie wszystkich parametrów i projektów będzie już za nami - w kolejnym etapie przejdziemy
do finalizacji zamówienia. Wyprodukujemy gry lub puzzle - w wysokiej jakości i zgodne z Twoimi
oczekiwaniami.

KROK 4: DOSTAWA

**Odbierz przesyłkę z Twoimi własnymi produktami**

Na “ostatniej prostej” zapakujemy produkty w dobrze zabezpieczone kartony zbiorcze oraz umieścimy je
na palecie. Następnie przekażemy bezpośrednio do firmy kurierskiej, która dopilnuje, aby dotarły do
Ciebie szybko i sprawnie - prosto pod wskazany adres.

## Produkcja gier, planszówek i kart bez żadnych tajemnic.

**Poznaj odpowiedzi na najczęściej zadawane pytania**

### Jaki jest czas realizacji?

Przy standardowych zamówieniach i płynności produkcyjnej - czas realizacji nie powinien przekroczyć
4 tygodni. Jest on liczony od ostatecznej akceptacji druków.

### Kiedy można zlecić produkcję?

Zlecenia na produkcję gier planszowych i karcianych, a także puzzli przyjmujemy przez cały rok. Z
doświadczenia jednak wiemy, że w trzecim kwartale każdego roku (od września do grudnia) zamówień
jest zdecydowanie więcej.

To sprawia, że od kilku lat, właśnie w tym okresie, odmawiamy przyjęcia zleceń poza harmonogramem
ustalonym wcześniej. Dlatego mocno zachęcamy do uzupełnienia magazynów i zlecenia produkcji przed
tym gorącym okresem w branży poligraficznej.

### Czy wykonują Państwo prototypy produktu?

Nie wykonujemy prototypów produktów. Jednak w razie potrzeby - dostarczamy próbki gier, układanek i
kart z poprzednich realizacji.

### Czy można wykonać autorski produkt?

Przy zachowaniu minimum logistycznego - jak najbardziej tak! Przy dedykowanej produkcji pod
konkretną specyfikację techniczną musimy mieć na uwadze, że często wiążę się ona ze stworzeniem
nowych wykrojników czy matryc. To oczywiście znajduje swoje odzwierciedlenie w cenie (ale tylko przy
pierwszej produkcji).

### Jakie jest minimalne zamówienie?

Minimum logistyczne to 500 sztuk (w przypadku puzzli i gier planszowych) oraz 1000 sztuk (w
przypadku gier karcianych i książek).

### Ile są Państwo w stanie wyprodukować?

Nasze możliwości produkcyjne zależą od rodzaju oraz stopnia skomplikowania produktu. Na przykład:
przy standardowych puzzlach możemy dostarczyć nawet 200 tysięcy egzemplarzy miesięcznie.

### Jak wyglądają płatności?

Po akceptacji ostatecznych druków, prosimy o wykonanie przedpłaty na podstawie faktury proforma.
Przy dłuższej współpracy, możliwość negocjacji warunków. Płatność w walucie PLN, EUR lub USD.

Przy standardowych zamówieniach i płynności produkcyjnej - czas realizacji nie powinien przekroczyć
4 tygodni. Jest on liczony od ostatecznej akceptacji druków.

### Kiedy można zlecić produkcję?

Zlecenia na produkcję gier planszowych i karcianych, a także puzzli przyjmujemy przez cały rok. Z
doświadczenia jednak wiemy, że w trzecim kwartale każdego roku (od września do grudnia) zamówień
jest zdecydowanie więcej.

To sprawia, że od kilku lat, właśnie w tym okresie, odmawiamy przyjęcia zleceń poza harmonogramem
ustalonym wcześniej. Dlatego mocno zachęcamy do uzupełnienia magazynów i zlecenia produkcji przed
tym gorącym okresem w branży poligraficznej.

### Czy wykonują Państwo prototypy produktu?

Nie wykonujemy prototypów produktów. Jednak w razie potrzeby - dostarczamy próbki gier, układanek i
kart z poprzednich realizacji.

### Czy można wykonać autorski produkt?

Przy zachowaniu minimum logistycznego - jak najbardziej tak! Przy dedykowanej produkcji pod
konkretną specyfikację techniczną musimy mieć na uwadze, że często wiążę się ona ze stworzeniem
nowych wykrojników czy matryc. To oczywiście znajduje swoje odzwierciedlenie w cenie (ale tylko przy
pierwszej produkcji).

### Jakie jest minimalne zamówienie?

Minimum logistyczne to 500 sztuk (w przypadku puzzli i gier planszowych) oraz 1000 sztuk (w
przypadku gier karcianych i książek).

### Ile są Państwo w stanie wyprodukować?

Nasze możliwości produkcyjne zależą od rodzaju oraz stopnia skomplikowania produktu. Na przykład:
przy standardowych puzzlach możemy dostarczyć nawet 200 tysięcy egzemplarzy miesięcznie.

### Jak wyglądają płatności?

Po akceptacji ostatecznych druków, prosimy o wykonanie przedpłaty na podstawie faktury proforma.
Przy dłuższej współpracy, możliwość negocjacji warunków. Płatność w walucie PLN, EUR lub USD.

## Sudoku puzzles online

[[Sudoku]][212]Some of us enjoy variety in the challenges we give ourselves. Do you also love
numbers? Then you can try out our [sudoku online][213] ♥ They are such a satisfying challenge. And
they are great when you only have your mobile phone and find it too small for a jigsaw puzzle.

[Create beautiful, personal greeting cards][214] and send them to friends and family as online

and does not require an account.

### What awaits you on Jigidi?

Well, roughly:
* Hours and hours of **fun relaxation** and **mental training** through the experience of creating
  and solving puzzles while connecting with **new friends** from all over the world.
* A remarkable level of **new knowledge** and gentle training of your **cognitive skills**.
* The **challenge** and **joy** of creating puzzles from your heart and mind for people from all
  over the world to enjoy and respond to.
* Puzzles that’ll let you **travel the world** from wherever you are.

And so much more ☺

So, are you ready to be curious, creative, and kind with us? Check the infoboxes to the right and
join us in Jigidi-land!

## Jigidi Daily Jigsaw Puzzle

[ [Crossing] ][208]

Make jigsaw puzzles part of your daily routine ? Every day, we curate a new jigsaw puzzle for you to
solve and enjoy. Try out the [daily jigsaw puzzles,][209] or follow us on [Facebook][210] and
[Twitter][211] to get our daily treats directly in your news flow.

## Sudoku puzzles online

[[Sudoku]][212]Some of us enjoy variety in the challenges we give ourselves. Do you also love
numbers? Then you can try out our [sudoku online][213] ♥ They are such a satisfying challenge. And
they are great when you only have your mobile phone and find it too small for a jigsaw puzzle.

## Greeting Card Jigsaw Puzzle Creator

[Create beautiful, personal greeting cards][214] and send them to friends and family as online
jigsaw puzzles on social media or by email. It’s free, fun and easy to create jigsaw greeting cards
and does not require an account.

#### How do I Join Jigidi?

When you join Jigidi, you can save your progress, create your own puzzles, and communicate with your
fellow puzzlers from all over the world. It’s free, and no personal info is required.

[Join Jigidi][215]

#### How do I solve or create a puzzle?

You’ll find all you need to know to start using Jigidi here:

[Get me the Jigidi basics, please][216]

#### What are the rules for Jigidi?

Jigidi is a community that runs on curiousity, creativity and kindness, and we have guidelines we
steer by. In the guidelines we write ‘we celebrate what connects us’:

[Give me the do’s and don’t’s on Jigidi][217]

# Turn Any Photo into an Online Jigsaw Puzzle

Upload a photo, pick your piece count, and start playing in seconds.

Jigsawify turns your photos into playable jigsaw puzzles right in the browser. Works on desktop and
mobile — no app install required. Upload a photo, choose from 4 to 1,000 pieces, and start playing
in seconds.

## Why People Choose Jigsawify

## JigsawPuzzles.io - Free multiplayer jigsaw puzzles for you and your friends!

JigsawPuzzles.io provides a new way for puzzle fans all over the world to unite and cooperatively
solve puzzles together. We've hand-picked thousands of beautiful, high-quality, family-friendly
images from a variety of talented amateur and professional photographers across the globe. This
new-meets-old concept brings cooperative online multiplayer to a gaming tradition that people have
enjoyed for centuries.

The history of jigsaw puzzles dates back as early as the 16th century, where cartographer John
Spilsbury of London first created them out of wood. They were originally intended to be used as a
learning aid for teaching geography and national boundaries on maps.

In the modern day, we've expanded from these humble beginnings to feature countless different types
of artwork and photos on our jigsaw puzzles. However, we think some of our best puzzles are still
rooted in this tradition of exploring geography and other nations around the world.

Piece together a scenic beach setting from the Spanish Riviera, or check out the vibrant colors and
lights of Tokyo's metropolitan sprawl. JigsawPuzzles.io brings some of the world's most breathtaking
vistas and locales right into your browser - one piece at a time!

## How to Play

Click on any image above to join a public jigsaw puzzle game - the difficulty and number of players
currently solving each puzzle is shown at the top of the image.

If you'd like to play a private game by yourself or with friends, ** Sign in** at the top of the
page and then click the ** Catalog** button.

From the catalog you can browse images and choose one to play.

To view and resume progress on any incomplete puzzles you've been working on, simply click the ** My
Puzzles** button at the top of the page.

Play solo, or invite others to join your game! Once you've started, click the ** Invite** button to
generate a link, then share this with your friends to have them join the fun.

Questions, Comments, or Need help? Drop us a line on our social media links above, and be sure to
check back regularly as we continue to add new puzzles each week!

Thank You!

## JigsawPuzzles.io - Free multiplayer jigsaw puzzles for you and your friends!

JigsawPuzzles.io provides a new way for puzzle fans all over the world to unite and cooperatively
solve puzzles together. We've hand-picked thousands of beautiful, high-quality, family-friendly
images from a variety of talented amateur and professional photographers across the globe. This
new-meets-old concept brings cooperative online multiplayer to a gaming tradition that people have
enjoyed for centuries.

The history of jigsaw puzzles dates back as early as the 16th century, where cartographer John
Spilsbury of London first created them out of wood. They were originally intended to be used as a
learning aid for teaching geography and national boundaries on maps.

In the modern day, we've expanded from these humble beginnings to feature countless different types
of artwork and photos on our jigsaw puzzles. However, we think some of our best puzzles are still
rooted in this tradition of exploring geography and other nations around the world.

Piece together a scenic beach setting from the Spanish Riviera, or check out the vibrant colors and
lights of Tokyo's metropolitan sprawl. JigsawPuzzles.io brings some of the world's most breathtaking
vistas and locales right into your browser - one piece at a time!

## How to Play

Click on any image above to join a public jigsaw puzzle game - the difficulty and number of players
currently solving each puzzle is shown at the top of the image.

If you'd like to play a private game by yourself or with friends, ** Sign in** at the top of the
page and then click the ** Catalog** button.

From the catalog you can browse images and choose one to play.

To view and resume progress on any incomplete puzzles you've been working on, simply click the ** My
Puzzles** button at the top of the page.

Play solo, or invite others to join your game! Once you've started, click the ** Invite** button to
generate a link, then share this with your friends to have them join the fun.

Questions, Comments, or Need help? Drop us a line on our social media links above, and be sure to
check back regularly as we continue to add new puzzles each week!

## The Special Touches
* [Whimsy Jigsaw Pieces of Ballet Dancers.]
  
  ### Whimsy Pieces
  
  Every Liberty Puzzle contains our signature “whimsy” pieces, hand-drawn in the shape of figurals,
  animals, plants, geometric shapes, and other unique designs that complement the image of the
  puzzle. Guaranteed to charm and delight as you find and fit each one.
* [The exquisite packaging that our puzzles come in!]
  
  ### Exquisite Packaging
  
  Attention to detail is incredibly important to us, that is why our packaging is as beautiful as
  our puzzles. A box made of high-end materials filled with pieces ensconced in hand-folded tissue;
  all the details that matter for gifting and collecting.
* [Liberty Puzzle Eagle Shaped Whimsy Piece with Liberty Logo.]
  
  ### Piece Replacement
  
  There is nothing more disheartening to a puzzler than a missing piece, resulting in a puzzle that
  was never really complete. Whether you lost it or the dog ate it, we will remake/replace the piece
  you are missing and send it to you to make your masterpiece whole again.

## The Special Touches
* [Whimsy Jigsaw Pieces of Ballet Dancers.]
  
  ### Whimsy Pieces
  
  Every Liberty Puzzle contains our signature “whimsy” pieces, hand-drawn in the shape of figurals,
  animals, plants, geometric shapes, and other unique designs that complement the image of the
  puzzle. Guaranteed to charm and delight as you find and fit each one.
* [The exquisite packaging that our puzzles come in!]
  
  ### Exquisite Packaging
  
  Attention to detail is incredibly important to us, that is why our packaging is as beautiful as
  our puzzles. A box made of high-end materials filled with pieces ensconced in hand-folded tissue;
  all the details that matter for gifting and collecting.
* [Liberty Puzzle Eagle Shaped Whimsy Piece with Liberty Logo.]
  
  ### Piece Replacement
  
  There is nothing more disheartening to a puzzler than a missing piece, resulting in a puzzle that
  was never really complete. Whether you lost it or the dog ate it, we will remake/replace the piece
  you are missing and send it to you to make your masterpiece whole again.

Intelligent Sensor Tracking: Advanced sensors monitor every puzzle sheet through cutting and

Transparent Machinery: Our equipment features see-through panels to eliminate hidden corners,

Supervised Sealing: All pieces are securely sealed into durable bags under continuous supervision,
guaranteeing a 100% complete puzzle in every box.

JIGSAW PUZZLE MANUFACTURING IN THE USA — CUSTOM PUZZLES, PACKAGING & ON-DEMAND SOLUTIONS

German engineering meets U.S. get-it-done mentality. We quietly manufacture puzzles for many of the
best-known brands in the U.S. and European markets. They trust us to bring their artwork and brand
vision to life every single day. We can do the same for you.

Global Expertise.
Local Know-How.

Backed by German engineering and built in the U.S., Ludo Fact combines world-class manufacturing
with deep puzzle market expertise—helping brands bring ideas to life with products that look great
and meet the expectations of puzzle fans.

[

#### Puzzles

High-Quality Jigsaw Puzzle Manufacturing

Great puzzles start with great manufacturing. At Ludo Fact, we combine precision cutting, premium
materials, and in-house die-making to deliver puzzles with perfect fit and consistent
quality—trusted by leading brands.

][15] [

#### Packaging

Rigid Set-Up Box Manufacturing

Our packaging roots run deep. For decades, this facility has produced rigid set-up boxes for U.S.
brands. Today, we continue that tradition with premium lid-and-base packaging for a wide range of
products.

][16]
[

#### Board Games

Reliable Board Game Production

Ludo Fact brings board games to market with reliable production and efficient assembly, sourcing
quality components through our network and assembling them in the USA.

][17]

#### ON DEMAND PUZZLE PRODUCTION

Personalized & Print-On-Demand Puzzles

Ludo Fact enables personalized, on-demand puzzle programs—producing and fulfilling puzzles only
after purchase, without the need for inventory.

Smart Solutions for Puzzle Brands

Every puzzle brand is different. Our team works closely with customers to develop practical
production solutions—from packaging ideas and materials to efficient manufacturing strategies that
help products succeed in the marketplace.

#### CENTRALLY LOCATED IN THE USA

Our Lafayette, Indiana facility sits at the crossroads of America’s transportation network, allowing
us to ship products quickly and efficiently across the United States.

#### FSC certification and green initiatives

#### We help U.S. puzzle brands expand into Europe through our German manufacturing and distribution
#### network.

Your
Partner
In Success

"Ludo Fact has been an incredible partner. Their team understands puzzles, understands
manufacturing, and consistently delivers the quality our customers expect."

-Key Brand Partner

#### Manufacturing Puzzles Shouldn’t Be Complicated

Working overseas often means long lead times, unpredictable shipping costs, and time-zone
challenges. With **Ludo Fact’s U.S. puzzle manufacturing,** you gain a reliable partner focused on
quality, speed, and clear communication.
* No ocean freight delays
* No port congestion surprises
* No late-night calls across time zones
* Faster turnaround and dependable delivery

#### Let’s get your next puzzle into production.

Request a quote and speak with our team today.

## Our Mission
* #### Elevating Learning through Play
  
  We are committed to redefining learning by creating puzzles and board games that spark curiosity,
  critical thinking, and creativity. Our mission is to provide a platform where players can absorb
  knowledge and enhance their cognitive skills while having a blast.
* #### Crafting Moments of Connection
  
  We believe in the magic of shared experiences. Our mission is to bring people closer together,
  whether they are family members, friends, or colleagues, by offering engaging games that foster
  meaningful connections, collaboration, and healthy competition.
* #### Empowering Personal Development
  
  Our mission extends beyond entertainment; we strive to empower personal growth. We design our
  products to encourage resilience, strategic thinking, and adaptability, providing players with
  valuable life skills that extend beyond the gaming table.
* #### Enriching Lives and Relationships
  
  We are driven by the belief that our puzzles and board games can create lasting memories and
  strengthen bonds. Our mission is to enhance the quality of life for individuals and families by
  offering a means of relaxation, joy, and shared experiences.

## Enterprise Introduction

Ningbo Uli Stationery Co., Ltd., established in 2010, is a professional manufacturer of premium
paper-based intellectual toys and children’s publications. Our diverse range includes educational
puzzles, tabletop game sets, preschool educational cards, and other innovative high-end paper
products. We cater to over 30 countries, including Europe, America, Australia, South America, Japan,
and South Korea. With a spacious 25,000 square meter facility, an independent R&D design team, and
numerous domestic and international patents and trademarks, our annual sales in domestic and
international markets have reached 150 million RMB.

Impressed by the ingenuity of Ningbo Uli’s offerings. The educational cards and publications have

I’ve been a loyal customer of Ningbo Youli for years, and I can’t speak highly enough of their

development flourish through play. Thank you for setting a gold standard in the industry!

Ningbo Uli Stationery has truly transformed the way my family learns and plays. The thoughtfulness

## Our Mission
* #### Elevating Learning through Play
  
  We are committed to redefining learning by creating puzzles and board games that spark curiosity,
  critical thinking, and creativity. Our mission is to provide a platform where players can absorb
  knowledge and enhance their cognitive skills while having a blast.
* #### Crafting Moments of Connection
  
  We believe in the magic of shared experiences. Our mission is to bring people closer together,
  whether they are family members, friends, or colleagues, by offering engaging games that foster
  meaningful connections, collaboration, and healthy competition.
* #### Empowering Personal Development
  
  Our mission extends beyond entertainment; we strive to empower personal growth. We design our
  products to encourage resilience, strategic thinking, and adaptability, providing players with
  valuable life skills that extend beyond the gaming table.
* #### Enriching Lives and Relationships
  
  We are driven by the belief that our puzzles and board games can create lasting memories and
  strengthen bonds. Our mission is to enhance the quality of life for individuals and families by
  offering a means of relaxation, joy, and shared experiences.

## Enterprise Introduction

Ningbo Uli Stationery Co., Ltd., established in 2010, is a professional manufacturer of premium
paper-based intellectual toys and children’s publications. Our diverse range includes educational
puzzles, tabletop game sets, preschool educational cards, and other innovative high-end paper
products. We cater to over 30 countries, including Europe, America, Australia, South America, Japan,
and South Korea. With a spacious 25,000 square meter facility, an independent R&D design team, and
numerous domestic and international patents and trademarks, our annual sales in domestic and
international markets have reached 150 million RMB.

exhibiting and selling puzzles. If you wish to buy, sell or just learn about old (antique) puzzles,
you are invited to explore my web site and contact me at: .

## Why B2B Buyers Choose Printing Partners

### One facility, one accountable team

Your project runs press to mailbox inside our Indianapolis plant. Multi-shift production means
deadlines get met by people you can call by name.

### Certified color management

G7 Master Colorspace qualification and ISO 9001:2015 workflows mean your brand red is your brand
red, on every run, on every stock.

### Mailing built into the workflow

Most printers hand mail off to a third party. We plan postage, addressing, and USPS logistics into
your quote from day one, which protects your in-home date and your budget across the 50M+ pieces we
mail a year.

### Family owned since 1989

A multi-generational family business now in its fourth decade. The owners work in the building, and
it shows in how your job gets treated.

[Our history ›][126]
[Production floor of Printing Partners' commercial printing facility in Indianapolis]

## The Equipment Behind the Promise

Capability claims are easy. Iron is not. Heidelberg XL106 presses, [digital presses][127], automated
bindery, and in-house [mailing systems][128] run across multiple shifts on one floor in
Indianapolis.

If you want to know exactly what your job will run on, ask. We publish the full list, press by
press.

[Full equipment list ›][129]

## Built for Organizations With a Brand Standard to Protect

Recurring publications, compliance-sensitive documents, campaign mailings, branded environments. We
are structured for buyers who print on a schedule and answer to a brand standard.

### Higher Education

View books, magazines, [recruitment mail][130], and event materials that hold a university brand
standard.

### Healthcare

Patient communications and facility signage produced under documented [ISO 9001:2015][131]
workflows.

### Nonprofits and Associations

Appeal mailings, annual reports, and member publications with [postage planned to stretch the
budget][132].

### Agencies and Brand Teams

A [G7 qualified][133] production partner that hits the proof you sold your client.

### Financial and Professional Services

Statements, collateral, and direct mail handled with accuracy and discretion.

## What Clients Say

> We appreciate the care, attention to detail, and professionalism you consistently provide.

**Christi Perry**, Purdue Brand Studio

Family Owned and Operated

## One Family. One Standard of Quality.

Printing Partners is not run by a holding company or a private equity group. It is run by the
O’Briens, a proud Catholic family whose values show up in how the work gets done: honest estimates,
careful proofing, and a refusal to let a job leave the building until it is right.

Five O’Briens are on the floor and on the phones every day, and the whole team gets treated like

carry our name and yours. Buyers notice. In a recent competitive proposal, our family ownership was
cited as a major factor in why Printing Partners was selected.

## Printing That Respects the Forest

Printing Partners is an FSC certified printer. When your job runs on FSC certified paper, it carries
independent assurance that the fiber came from responsibly managed forests, and your printed piece
can say so. [Ask for FSC options in your quote][134], for many projects the cost difference is
smaller than you expect.

[FSC certified printing ›][135]

## Commercial Printing Questions, Answered

How do I get a commercial printing quote in Indianapolis?

Request a quote through the Printing Partners estimate form or call 317-635-2282. Include quantity,
finished size, page count, paper preference, and your in-hands date. An estimator who works on the
production floor, not in a call center, will price the job and flag anything in your spec that could
save money.

Does Printing Partners offer both offset and digital printing?

Yes. Printing Partners runs Heidelberg XL106 offset presses for high volume work and digital presses
for short runs and fast turnarounds, all in one Indianapolis facility. Quantity, schedule, and paper
choice usually decide the method. Send your specs and we will quote the route that costs less
without compromising quality. Still deciding? See our guide to [choosing between offset and
digital][136].

Can you mail my printed pieces too?

Yes. Printing Partners prints, addresses, sorts, and delivers your mailing to USPS from the same
building. Integrated direct mail services include list processing and postage planning, which often
reduces postage enough to offset part of the print cost. See our [bulk mailing rates][137] guide for
how postage tiers work.

cards, a wire-O bound notebook, and an open brochure on a white studio background]

## Certified, Audited, and Accountable

35+

Years in Business

13,000+

Customers Served

50M+

Mail Pieces Per Year

[ G7 Master Colorspace Qualified ][113] [ ISO 9001:2015 Certified ][114] [ FSC Certified ][115] [
Family Owned Since 1989 ][116]

Printing Partners is a G7 Master Colorspace Qualified, ISO 9001:2015 certified, and FSC certified
commercial printing company in Indianapolis, Indiana.

## Everything Your Project Needs, Under One Roof

One file handoff, one accountable team, one invoice. Your job never leaves our control between proof
and delivery.

[Banded stacks of freshly printed documents from a Heidelberg offset run at Printing Partners]

### Offset Printing

High-volume runs on Heidelberg XL106 presses with UV capability. Sharp detail, consistent color, and
per-unit costs that drop as quantity goes up.

[Learn more about offset printing ›][117]
[Short run digital print business cards produced at Printing Partners in Indianapolis]

### Digital Printing

Short runs and fast turnarounds without plates. Ideal for versioned pieces, proofs of concept, and
print-on-demand programs.

[Learn more about digital printing ›][118]
[Bulk mailing department at Printing Partners preparing direct mail for USPS delivery]

### Direct Mail and Fulfillment

We print, address, sort, and deliver to USPS from the same building. Postage discounts and list
handling included in the plan, not bolted on.

[Learn more about direct mail and fulfillment ›][119]
[Bindery and finishing equipment in operation at Printing Partners' Indianapolis facility]

### Bindery and Finishing

Cutting, folding, binding, foil stamping, and embossing handled in house. No subcontractor delays,
no finger-pointing.

[Learn more about bindery and finishing ›][120]
[Large format printer producing a vibrant wide format print at Printing Partners]

### Wide Format and Signage

Banners, displays, and signage produced to the same color standards as your collateral, so the booth
matches the brochure.

[Learn more about wide format and signage ›][121]
[Custom printed retail packaging produced by Printing Partners for specialty food brands]

### Custom Packaging

Boxes, sleeves, and labels that survive the shelf and the unboxing video. Structural and print
expertise in one shop.

[Learn more about custom packaging ›][122]
[Square brochure with rounded corners and Wire-O binding, an example of book and publication
printing]

### Books and Publications

Perfect bound, saddle stitched, or casebound. Magazines, catalogs, journals, and books built to spec
and to schedule.

[Learn more about book and publication printing ›][123]
[Branded promotional products decorated by Printing Partners in Indianapolis]

### Promotional Products

Branded merchandise sourced and decorated through the same team that prints your collateral, with
the same color discipline.

[Learn more about promotional products ›][124]
[Browse all products ›][125]

## Why B2B Buyers Choose Printing Partners

### One facility, one accountable team

Your project runs press to mailbox inside our Indianapolis plant. Multi-shift production means
deadlines get met by people you can call by name.

### Certified color management

G7 Master Colorspace qualification and ISO 9001:2015 workflows mean your brand red is your brand
red, on every run, on every stock.

### Mailing built into the workflow

Most printers hand mail off to a third party. We plan postage, addressing, and USPS logistics into
your quote from day one, which protects your in-home date and your budget across the 50M+ pieces we
mail a year.

### Family owned since 1989

A multi-generational family business now in its fourth decade. The owners work in the building, and
it shows in how your job gets treated.

[Our history ›][126]
[Production floor of Printing Partners' commercial printing facility in Indianapolis]

## The Equipment Behind the Promise

Capability claims are easy. Iron is not. Heidelberg XL106 presses, [digital presses][127], automated
bindery, and in-house [mailing systems][128] run across multiple shifts on one floor in
Indianapolis.

If you want to know exactly what your job will run on, ask. We publish the full list, press by
press.

[Full equipment list ›][129]

## Built for Organizations With a Brand Standard to Protect

Recurring publications, compliance-sensitive documents, campaign mailings, branded environments. We
are structured for buyers who print on a schedule and answer to a brand standard.

### Higher Education

View books, magazines, [recruitment mail][130], and event materials that hold a university brand
standard.

### Healthcare

Patient communications and facility signage produced under documented [ISO 9001:2015][131]
workflows.

### Nonprofits and Associations

Appeal mailings, annual reports, and member publications with [postage planned to stretch the
budget][132].

### Agencies and Brand Teams

A [G7 qualified][133] production partner that hits the proof you sold your client.

### Financial and Professional Services

Statements, collateral, and direct mail handled with accuracy and discretion.

## What Clients Say

> We appreciate the care, attention to detail, and professionalism you consistently provide.

**Christi Perry**, Purdue Brand Studio

Family Owned and Operated

## One Family. One Standard of Quality.

Printing Partners is not run by a holding company or a private equity group. It is run by the
O’Briens, a proud Catholic family whose values show up in how the work gets done: honest estimates,
careful proofing, and a refusal to let a job leave the building until it is right.

[Joel O’Brien, owner of Printing Partners]

Five O’Briens are on the floor and on the phones every day, and the whole team gets treated like
extended family. Our faith sets the standard, and the standard is simple: a product good enough to
carry our name and yours. Buyers notice. In a recent competitive proposal, our family ownership was
cited as a major factor in why Printing Partners was selected.

## Printing That Respects the Forest

Printing Partners is an FSC certified printer. When your job runs on FSC certified paper, it carries
independent assurance that the fiber came from responsibly managed forests, and your printed piece
can say so. [Ask for FSC options in your quote][134], for many projects the cost difference is
smaller than you expect.

[FSC certified printing ›][135]

## Commercial Printing Questions, Answered

How do I get a commercial printing quote in Indianapolis?

Request a quote through the Printing Partners estimate form or call 317-635-2282. Include quantity,
finished size, page count, paper preference, and your in-hands date. An estimator who works on the
production floor, not in a call center, will price the job and flag anything in your spec that could
save money.

Does Printing Partners offer both offset and digital printing?

Yes. Printing Partners runs Heidelberg XL106 offset presses for high volume work and digital presses
for short runs and fast turnarounds, all in one Indianapolis facility. Quantity, schedule, and paper
choice usually decide the method. Send your specs and we will quote the route that costs less
without compromising quality. Still deciding? See our guide to [choosing between offset and
digital][136].

Can you mail my printed pieces too?

Yes. Printing Partners prints, addresses, sorts, and delivers your mailing to USPS from the same
building. Integrated direct mail services include list processing and postage planning, which often
reduces postage enough to offset part of the print cost. See our [bulk mailing rates][137] guide for
how postage tiers work.

# Online Puzzle Maker - Create Your Own Interactive Puzzles

the interactive puzzle maker for creating awesome, customisable and online embeddable puzzles

## Create Crossword Puzzle

Real-time crossword puzzle generator for creating your own interactive crossword puzzles with ease

The generator contains many features like styling, hidden solution, embedding, word banks and more!

start building
Preview

## Create Word Search

Generate your first word search puzzle within seconds and see the result directly.

Create a word search with easy and friendly drag interactivity for selecting the words and discover
the broad range of features available

start building
Preview

## Create Jigsaw Puzzle

Create your own jigsaw puzzle within a few clicks. Upload your image or enter an external URL and
your jigsaw puzzle is ready!

The total number of puzzle pieces, the helper image, the tracking of completions, everything can be
tweaked just the way you like.

start building
Preview

## Create Matching Game

Create your own set of cards, using any combination of text, image and audio to challenge the puzzle
player

Connect the cards by drawing a line between them, just like you used to do in the offline puzzle
magazines

start building
Preview

••• or try one of the many other activity generators on the platform •••

Discover all activity generators

## Specific benefits for teachers

### Wide range of educational activity types

Create all sorts of activities from your word lists, exam material or other type of content. Use the
puzzle maker that fits your use case the best.

### Privacy comes first by default.

No ads, no analytics, no weird cookies. Optional player registration. You can pick whatever info you
need from your players (if any).

### Super easy to use in any classroom or training

Create your activity, share the QR code or link and you are ready to reap the benefits of being a
puzzle maker.

## extend your activities with loads of features

### real-time puzzle maker

Add content, make changes and see your puzzle come to life in the real-time preview
By viewing your changes in real-time, it is very easy and quick to develop a new puzzle or other
educational activity, since you know exactly what you'll get.

### [Tracking puzzle results][1]

Tracking your puzzle results is super easy. Enable pre- or post-registration, choose your own
registration fields like 'first name' or 'student ID' and it will track of all the puzzle player
results in real-time.

Keeping track of results allows you to automatically check how each student performed, if he/she
completed the activity and what answers they got right and wrong.

See all of the options

### [Embed activities in one copy-paste][2]

Embedding your activity is as easy as copying the embed code from the activity page and pasting it
in your CMS or LMS.
Embedding an activity grants you a white label version of the activity. No Puzzel.org recognition.
No headers, no footers. Just the activity.
Try the sample embed code

### [PuzzleGPT: AI puzzle generation][3]

Since the huge popularity of ChatGPT and other public AI language models have taken over the news,
Puzzel.org wanted to join the fun and make the artificial intelligence even more accessible by
integrating it into puzzle building.

All sorts of puzzle types have now gotten integrated AI support for paid accounts, ranging from
completely generated thematic crossword puzzles to image generated jigsaw puzzles.

Read more

### [Add message on completion][4]

Adding a climax to your activity is a great way to boost the dopamine levels of your players. The
completion message is the perfect way of sharing possible information, showing festive confetti or
directing the player to the next activity.

Completion messages can be added to almost any activity type and are highly customisable.

Discover all of the settings

### All of your puzzles are completely customisable.

You can match any of the colors used with your own school/brand colors to make the puzzle feel extra
native.
Adjust all sorts of settings to tune the activity to exactly the gameplay you are looking for.

## Discover all of the multiplayer options

### Challenge each other!

Every activity has the option to enable 'challenge mode' where you can challenge another player to a
battle who finishes first. With real-time feedback on the progress for extra excitement while
learning!

### Play in teams

Playing in teams allows to solve puzzles together and create a live team competition. Feedback is in
real-time, synchronizing correct answers and updating progress for everyone to see.

### Play in turns

Play with real game mechanics like taking turns to play your own custom online board game or an
online card game like memory or quartets.

### Free by default. Upgrade for more.

### What's included in every paid subscription
* create an unlimited number of activities

## About the game

Online puzzles is a logic game for adults and children that can be played on a computer, tablet or
smartphone. Multiplayer Puzzles is an online version of the game for several players. Regular Jigsaw
Puzzles playing improves memory, mental clarity and slow the aging of brain cells.

## Rules of the game

At the beginning of the game, the selected picture is divided into many small fragments of various
shapes, the number of which depends on the chosen difficulty. The higher the difficulty, the more
fragments you need to collect. The goal of the game is to return the fragments to their places in
order to restore the original image in the shortest possible time.

## About the game

Online puzzles is a logic game for adults and children that can be played on a computer, tablet or
smartphone. Multiplayer Puzzles is an online version of the game for several players. Regular Jigsaw
Puzzles playing improves memory, mental clarity and slow the aging of brain cells.

## Rules of the game

At the beginning of the game, the selected picture is divided into many small fragments of various
shapes, the number of which depends on the chosen difficulty. The higher the difficulty, the more
fragments you need to collect. The goal of the game is to return the fragments to their places in
order to restore the original image in the shortest possible time.

## Custom Puzzles

Creating personalised jigsaw puzzles can also have emotional benefits, as it can be a relaxing and
meditative activity that helps reduce stress and anxiety. It can also be a great way to bond with
family and friends, as working together to solve a puzzle can foster communication and teamwork.
Additionally, completing a puzzle provides a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction, boosting
self-esteem and well-being. Overall, the act of creating personalised puzzles can be a fun and
rewarding experience that promotes both mental and emotional wellness.

#### [CUSTOM SIZES][137]

[Play Video][138]

### About Us

Here at Puzzles Australia, we’re proud to be a family-owned and operated business based right here
in Australia. Every personalised puzzle we create is carefully crafted to order in Melbourne. We’re
dedicated to using high-quality materials for our custom puzzles and actively support local
Australian businesses whenever possible.

## Adult Puzzles

Elevate your cognitive abilities and boost productivity with our collection of adult jigsaw puzzles.
Designed to increase your IQ, enhance problem-solving skills, and foster better collaboration and
teamwork.

If you don’t have your own image, you’re welcome to browse through our collection of stock images
and discover the ideal one for your puzzle.

### Corporate Team
### Building Puzzles

Team-building activities in the corporate world aim to improve collaboration and communication.
Completing jigsaw puzzles can help with this. It’s a fun way for employees to work together, solve
problems, and build better relationships. Jigsaw puzzles encourage critical thinking and patience,
which are important skills in the workplace. Using puzzles can help create a more united team that’s
ready to face challenges together.

Jigsaw puzzles offer a one-of-a-kind way to introduce a new product or event. They make for an ideal
retirement gift, employee of the month recognition, or a unique invitation for a work-related
gathering.

#### [Get Your Gift Voucher][147]

## Kids Puzzles

Looking for an engaging and educational activity for your kids? Let them dive into the world of
puzzles! Studies have shown that puzzle-making offers a wide range of cognitive and developmental
benefits for children. From boosting mental stimulation and enhancing visual-spatial skills to
improving memory, problem-solving, and creativity, puzzle assembly is not only fun but also great
for kids’ overall development.

Unplug your kids from screens and witness the joy on their faces as they conquer their puzzles,
giving them a genuine endorphin rush. Additionally, personalized jigsaw puzzles make unique and
thoughtful gifts for any special occasion, making them perfect for birthdays or holidays like
Christmas. Give your kids the gift of fun and learning with personalized puzzles!

Creating a collage jigsaw puzzle is a fantastic choice if you have multiple images you’d like to

Creating personalised jigsaw puzzles can also have emotional benefits, as it can be a relaxing and

family and friends, as working together to solve a puzzle can foster communication and teamwork.

### Corporate Team
### Building Puzzles

Team-building activities in the corporate world aim to improve collaboration and communication.
Completing jigsaw puzzles can help with this. It’s a fun way for employees to work together, solve
problems, and build better relationships. Jigsaw puzzles encourage critical thinking and patience,
which are important skills in the workplace. Using puzzles can help create a more united team that’s
ready to face challenges together.

Jigsaw puzzles offer a one-of-a-kind way to introduce a new product or event. They make for an ideal
retirement gift, employee of the month recognition, or a unique invitation for a work-related
gathering.

## Kids Puzzles

Looking for an engaging and educational activity for your kids? Let them dive into the world of
puzzles! Studies have shown that puzzle-making offers a wide range of cognitive and developmental
benefits for children. From boosting mental stimulation and enhancing visual-spatial skills to
improving memory, problem-solving, and creativity, puzzle assembly is not only fun but also great
for kids’ overall development.

Unplug your kids from screens and witness the joy on their faces as they conquer their puzzles,
giving them a genuine endorphin rush. Additionally, personalized jigsaw puzzles make unique and
thoughtful gifts for any special occasion, making them perfect for birthdays or holidays like
Christmas. Give your kids the gift of fun and learning with personalized puzzles!

## Common questions

### Are PuzzleSnap puzzles really free?

Yes. Every puzzle plays free in your browser. The site runs on display ads. There’s nothing to buy
and nothing to upgrade.

### Do I need an account to play?

No. Pick any puzzle and start playing. An account only matters if you want to save puzzles to a
profile or upload your own to the public gallery.

### Can I turn my own photo into a jigsaw?

Yes. The [Puzzle Maker][57] turns any photo into a playable jigsaw in under a minute. It’s free, no
signup, sharable with a link.

### How is PuzzleSnap different from other jigsaw sites?

Most jigsaw sites do one job: pre-built puzzles to play, or a maker for your own photos. PuzzleSnap
does both. Thousands of ready-to-play puzzles, plus a free photo-to-jigsaw tool.

### Does it work on my phone?

Yes. Every puzzle plays in your mobile browser. Drag pieces with your finger. No app to install.

### What’s the difficulty range?

From 9 pieces (a quick, calm solve) to 50 pieces (a real challenge). You pick when you start the
puzzle.

### What happened to im-a-puzzle.com?

Same puzzles, same experience, new domain. PuzzleSnap is the new name for the site that used to be
called I’m a Puzzle.

and nothing to upgrade.

puzzle.

Same puzzles, same experience, new domain. PuzzleSnap is the new name for the site that used to be
called I’m a Puzzle.

## Questions? We Have Answers

check_box

## How much does delivery cost?

Delivery costs depend on your location and order size.

We offer **free shipping** for orders above a certain value, while smaller orders include a small
delivery fee that varies by country. You’ll see the exact shipping cost calculated at checkout
before confirming your order.

check_box

## How long will it take to receive my puzzle?

Production usually takes 1–2 business days, and delivery times depend on the shipping option you
select:
• Standard delivery: ~7 business days (depending on destination)
• Express delivery: ~2 business days
Once your order is shipped, you’ll receive tracking details so you can follow your package’s
progress.

check_box

## What image formats can I upload?

We accept most common image file types: JPEG, PNG, and TIFF.
For best results, use high-resolution images (at least 150 DPI). The higher the quality of your
image, the sharper and more detailed your custom puzzle will look. If your image doesn’t meet the
recommended size, our system will notify you before checkout.

check_box

## Can I cancel or return my order?

Because each puzzle is custom-made to your chosen design, we can’t accept cancellations or returns
once production has started.
If you notice an issue with your order details or file, please contact us immediately after
purchase, and our support team will do their best to assist you before printing begins.

## Questions? We Have Answers

check_box

## How much does delivery cost?

Delivery costs depend on your location and order size.

We offer **free shipping** for orders above a certain value, while smaller orders include a small
delivery fee that varies by country. You’ll see the exact shipping cost calculated at checkout
before confirming your order.

check_box

## How long will it take to receive my puzzle?

Production usually takes 1–2 business days, and delivery times depend on the shipping option you
select:
• Standard delivery: ~7 business days (depending on destination)
• Express delivery: ~2 business days
Once your order is shipped, you’ll receive tracking details so you can follow your package’s
progress.

check_box

## What image formats can I upload?

We accept most common image file types: JPEG, PNG, and TIFF.
For best results, use high-resolution images (at least 150 DPI). The higher the quality of your
image, the sharper and more detailed your custom puzzle will look. If your image doesn’t meet the
recommended size, our system will notify you before checkout.

check_box

## Can I cancel or return my order?

Because each puzzle is custom-made to your chosen design, we can’t accept cancellations or returns
once production has started.
If you notice an issue with your order details or file, please contact us immediately after
purchase, and our support team will do their best to assist you before printing begins.

## Artists, Art Shows and Art Galleries

If you are an Artist or an Art Gallery looking for ways to increase your income and gain wider
exposure for your work, Jigsaw Puzzles are the perfect product for you. Launching your own range of
**“Special Edition” puzzles** opens up your Art to a wider audience, gives you a brandable,
merchandisable product to sell, and earns you an additional income.

[Contact Us][16]

## Museums, Zoos & Tourist Attractions

Jigsaw Puzzles make great souvenirs for sale in your gift store. Visitors are looking for a product
that will remind them of their visit and a puzzle of your attraction offers them exactly that. It’s
visual, fun, and priced right. Ask any gift store retail manager, **[location-specific Jigsaw
Puzzles][17]** are one of the top-selling items in their gift shop.

[Contact Us][18]
[Museum Sign][Museum Sign]

## Photographers and Digital Artists

Great images are always in demand and puzzles give people a reason to buy them. Generate additional
income by selling your photo and digital art as Jigsaw Puzzles. Launch your own range of exclusive
**[custom-printed Jigsaw Puzzles][19]** featuring your unique copyrighted images and start profiting
from your work.

[Contact Us][20]

## Parks, Clubs, and Resort Gift Stores

If you operate a business that attracts many visitors, you may wish to offer a puzzle in your gift
shop reflecting your brand and products or service. **[Branded location puzzles][21]** are
particularly suitable for venues such as clubs, hotels, beach resorts, amusement parks, or golf
courses. All we need is a photograph of your location or property to make a custom puzzle
specifically for your business. Let visitors take away a visual memory of their visit.

[Contact Us][22]
[Tourist Attraction][Tourist Attraction]
[Trade Show][Trade Show]

## Corporate Promotional Puzzles

Whether your company is celebrating a milestone anniversary or achievement, promoting your business
to your customers, or looking for a recognizable trade show giveaway, **custom-printed [promotional
puzzles][23]** offer an elegant and fun solution. A custom puzzle offers the opportunity to combine
your corporate imagery with your brand to create an elegant and fun product. We offer a range of
[puzzle sizes][24] and types to meet your needs.

[Contact Us][25]

## Puzzles for Education and Corporate Training

Need to get your message across? Puzzles are a great way to bring attention to facts and figures,
processes and procedures. To complete a puzzle, you need to pay attention to each piece and how it
fits with the others. Working closely on a puzzle makes you familiar with the image and the
information it contains. It’s a fun way to get your message across in the classroom or corporate
training room.

If you are planning on launching your own range of Puzzles or using a puzzle as a fundraiser or
commemorative gift, then you have come to the right place.

## Puzzle Manufacturers For

## Artists, Art Shows and Art Galleries

If you are an Artist or an Art Gallery looking for ways to increase your income and gain wider
exposure for your work, Jigsaw Puzzles are the perfect product for you. Launching your own range of
**“Special Edition” puzzles** opens up your Art to a wider audience, gives you a brandable,
merchandisable product to sell, and earns you an additional income.

[Contact Us][16]

## Museums, Zoos & Tourist Attractions

Jigsaw Puzzles make great souvenirs for sale in your gift store. Visitors are looking for a product
that will remind them of their visit and a puzzle of your attraction offers them exactly that. It’s
visual, fun, and priced right. Ask any gift store retail manager, **[location-specific Jigsaw
Puzzles][17]** are one of the top-selling items in their gift shop.

[Contact Us][18]
[Museum Sign][Museum Sign]
[Photographer][Photographer]

## Photographers and Digital Artists

Great images are always in demand and puzzles give people a reason to buy them. Generate additional
income by selling your photo and digital art as Jigsaw Puzzles. Launch your own range of exclusive
**[custom-printed Jigsaw Puzzles][19]** featuring your unique copyrighted images and start profiting
from your work.

[Contact Us][20]

## Parks, Clubs, and Resort Gift Stores

If you operate a business that attracts many visitors, you may wish to offer a puzzle in your gift
shop reflecting your brand and products or service. **[Branded location puzzles][21]** are
particularly suitable for venues such as clubs, hotels, beach resorts, amusement parks, or golf
courses. All we need is a photograph of your location or property to make a custom puzzle
specifically for your business. Let visitors take away a visual memory of their visit.

[Contact Us][22]
[Tourist Attraction][Tourist Attraction]
[Trade Show][Trade Show]

## Corporate Promotional Puzzles

Whether your company is celebrating a milestone anniversary or achievement, promoting your business
to your customers, or looking for a recognizable trade show giveaway, **custom-printed [promotional
puzzles][23]** offer an elegant and fun solution. A custom puzzle offers the opportunity to combine
your corporate imagery with your brand to create an elegant and fun product. We offer a range of
[puzzle sizes][24] and types to meet your needs.

[Contact Us][25]

## Puzzles for Education and Corporate Training

Need to get your message across? Puzzles are a great way to bring attention to facts and figures,
processes and procedures. To complete a puzzle, you need to pay attention to each piece and how it
fits with the others. Working closely on a puzzle makes you familiar with the image and the
information it contains. It’s a fun way to get your message across in the classroom or corporate
training room.

## [Puzzling Places][32]

### A VR Jigsaw Puzzle Game

[Puzzling Places][33] is a relaxing and wholesome 3D jigsaw puzzle game where you put together
hyper-realistic miniatures of beautiful places from around the globe. It’s is a modern take on an
age-old pastime that’s fun for the whole family, thanks to its simple rules, easy controls, and
comfortable playstyles. Play seated, standing, or at full roomscale!

**Learn more**: [Puzzling Places][34]

**Get it**: for [Meta Quest][35], [PS VR2][36], [Pico][37] or [Steam][38]

# Realities.io

## Making the Real World Explorable Through Immersive technologies

## reality meets spatial computing

As VR, AR, 3D engines become ubiquitous, the need for capturing the world in volumetric is becoming
extremely important. With years of experience work on VR Films and games, we at Realities.IO have
built the tools to **bring photogrammetry based assets into realtime engines**.

## Welcome to Subramaniam Colour Prints

# Jigsaw Puzzle Manufacturing

Looking for a reliable jigsaw puzzle manufacturer? Look no further than our company, your one-stop
destination for all your jigsaw puzzle production needs. With top-class printing machines, puzzle
punching machines, punching machines, pasting machines, and rigid box machines, we are fully
equipped to handle all your custom jigsaw puzzle manufacturing requirements.

Our skilled workforce and strict adherence to high-quality practices ensure that every project is
completed to perfection. Whether you need short run or large volume jigsaw puzzles, we guarantee the
best quality products.

As one of the leading jigsaw puzzle manufacturing companies, we take pride in our commitment to
customer satisfaction. Contact us today to experience the difference in quality and customer service
for all your jigsaw puzzle production needs.

Are you looking to manufacture custom cardboard jigsaw puzzles? Fill out our quote request form
below to get started. Provide us with details about your project, and our team will get back to you
with a tailored quote.

[**Click here to fill out the form**][40]

## Experience Premium Quality with our Paper Board Jigsaw Puzzles

At our company, we specialize in jigsaw puzzle production using high-quality paper board. While
jigsaw puzzle companies in the early 20th century used large hydraulic presses for manufacturing,
the roller press manufacturing process soon became more economical. More recently, laser-cutting
technology has also revolutionized the puzzle-making process.Our jigsaw puzzles range from four to
50 pieces, making them suitable for younger children, as well as more complex puzzles with over
40,000 pieces. We focus exclusively on flat paper board puzzles. Our commitment to quality and
attention to detail ensures that our customers receive only the best jigsaw puzzles available.

## Mitsubishi

The ultimate solution for high-quality, high-volume printing. This state-of-the-art machine is
equipped with a 6-color plus coater configuration, as well as UV interdeck at all stations. This
ensures that every print is of the highest quality, with vibrant colors and crisp images. With its

## ❤️ Support us ❤️

Tanggle.io is free to play, with no ads to back up the development.

You will help us a lot if you spread a word or become a subscriber!

[Subscribe][2]

## Piece rotation

Looking for a more realistic experience? Try piece rotation!

Just select "Hardmode" difficulty when creating a puzzle to enable rotating pieces.

## Animated puzzles

Experience puzzles like never before — with video puzzles where the image is alive!

Animated puzzles are available with a [subscription][3]. Browse all animated puzzles [here][4].

## Puzzle time-lapses

After finishing a puzzle, enjoy a time-lapse of your entire assembly process — and even export it as
a video!

Puzzle replays are available with a [subscription][5].

## Move multiple pieces at once

Right-click a piece to add it to your pocket. Hold right click to mass-pick or mass-place pieces.

Currently available only on PC.

## Alone or with friends

Puzzle at your own pace or team up with friends, family, or even new people from around the world!

Got a big crowd? Create a community and puzzle together!

## Upload your puzzle

You can turn any picture into your own custom puzzle!

Just upload a picture you love, and we'll create a puzzle from it.

## Vast puzzle gallery

Explore thousands of carefully selected images in our [puzzle gallery][6]!

Browse by category to find your favorite themes and discover something new every day.

## Free puzzles with zero ads

All the must-have features for puzzle enthusiasts are completely free — no ads, no data selling,
ever!

For larger puzzles and extra premium features, we offer an optional [subscription][7].

## Puzzles, the ultimate brain food

Puzzles offer a complete brain exercise. When you assemble a puzzle both the right & left
hemispheres of the brain work together to increase cognitive function. So whether you're a puzzle
prodigy or just want to brush up on your skills, our artist line will challenge you to expand your
mind and unleash your creativity.

[The Queen -Unified Pieces | Black-Owned Jigsaw Puzzle Company | 1000 Pieces]
[SEE OUR PIECES][61]
[Castronaut - Unified Pieces | Black-Owned Jigsaw Puzzle Company | 1000 Pieces]

## Our ARTISTS are the ish!

Artists of color have helped shape visual culture across the world, but they have not been aptly
recognized for their talent. Unified Pieces is amplifying these artists through puzzling, making
their art more accessible—transforming anyone into an art collector. Everyone deserves to have their
own collection of beautiful works of art, which is why we have created original pieces. With a focus
on diversity, we highlight the work of underrepresented artists, showcasing their styles and
techniques in one-of-a-kind puzzles.

## Puzzles, the ultimate brain food

Puzzles offer a complete brain exercise. When you assemble a puzzle both the right & left
hemispheres of the brain work together to increase cognitive function. So whether you're a puzzle
prodigy or just want to brush up on your skills, our artist line will challenge you to expand your
mind and unleash your creativity.

[SEE OUR PIECES][61]
[Castronaut - Unified Pieces | Black-Owned Jigsaw Puzzle Company | 1000 Pieces]

## Our ARTISTS are the ish!

Artists of color have helped shape visual culture across the world, but they have not been aptly
recognized for their talent. Unified Pieces is amplifying these artists through puzzling, making
their art more accessible—transforming anyone into an art collector. Everyone deserves to have their
own collection of beautiful works of art, which is why we have created original pieces. With a focus
on diversity, we highlight the work of underrepresented artists, showcasing their styles and
techniques in one-of-a-kind puzzles.
